book_channels.btc_morpho_ltv: Morpho BTC-backed USDC loan — keep-open, manage LTV only (alert 0.45 / max 0.50). Latent while collateral $0.
book_channels.usdc_cash: Working USDC + HY LTV Buffer ($1k floor) + One Card deposit. Float, not the store. Red-mode freeze applies to new free dollars.
book_channels.rh_sleeve: Agentic 40/60 (btc_digital_credit + stocks_growth) + BP (no floor) + RH margin bands if used.
book_channels.strc_jr: Listed STRC/SATA seat inside the 40% complex only. JR/SR is NOT this channel — Morpho never funds it.

nodes.title: USD overnight funding
facts: Overnight dollar (SOFR vs IORB) is the hinge that reprices BTC collateral and DeFi borrow in hours.
nodes.interpretation: Tight funding marks Morpho LTV (when collateral exists) and USDC mint. Not a recession forecast.
nodes.watch_if: SOFR−IORB widens or SOFR stale >2 sessions.

nodes.title: Real yields
facts: 10y TIPS is the duration + BTC-liquidity factor. Hits listed STRC mark.
nodes.interpretation: A cut that does not drop real rates is not a release. Do not rotate 40/60 on a 10bp print.
nodes.watch_if: DFII10 re-prices >25bp in a week without a matching valve.

nodes.title: Broad dollar
facts: Broad dollar up is typically BTC and risk down; confirmation for usd_liquidity, not a standalone trade.
nodes.interpretation: Ignore DXY tweets. Need BTC/equity confirmation.
nodes.watch_if: DTWEXBGS breaks a 20-session range with BTC confirmation.

nodes.title: BTC liquidity beta
facts: BTC is Morpho collateral and the 40% sleeve factor (MSTR / miners / BITA).
nodes.interpretation: Do not invent off-FCC BTC. ETF-flow theater is not this node. Alias Horizon capital-btc-liquidity.
nodes.watch_if: Spot gaps that would heat LTV if collateral were on; miners mark with it.

nodes.title: On-chain USD credit
facts: Morpho-class USDC borrow APR is the keep-open loan's cost. Card refi is ~5% vs ~29% only while this stays cheap.
nodes.interpretation: Ignore while principal and collateral are $0 and no refinance is on the table this week. Re-arm on a draw. Flag if borrow ≥ ~15%.
nodes.watch_if: Public Morpho USDC utilization spikes or APR ≥ 15%.

nodes.title: Equity vol
facts: 60% sleeve is TSLA / SPCX. DCA pause is RH margin heat >0.40, not VIX.
nodes.interpretation: Not a trade signal. Still show when VIX >30 as watch. Cash account → rh_margin latent.
nodes.watch_if: VIX >30 or TSLA/SPCX gap with margin on.

nodes.title: Hashprice × power
facts: Held miner sleeve (MARA / IREN / CLSK). ASIC engine MO exists and is SIC-parked.
nodes.interpretation: Miner-mark pressure is in-policy. ASIC deploy recs are not, while cash-stack / red holds.
nodes.watch_if: Hashprice breaks a 30d range or EIA power narrative shifts miner margins.

source.name: Hashrate Index + EIA Today in Energy

nodes.title: Listed Strategy preferred
facts: Listed STRC/SATA is the in-policy 40% credit seat. Unheld today. JR-strcUSX is a different product and is vetoed.
nodes.interpretation: Ignore while unheld and no residual. Do not count JR toward this node or toward HY.
nodes.watch_if: STRC spread vs DTB3 blows out, or BP ≥ $1 after red exit (seat becomes live).

nodes.title: Fed funds
facts: Official rate valve. Sets Morpho/HY opportunity cost and STRC duration. Alias Horizon macro-rates-regime.
nodes.interpretation: shut = restrictive. A cut without real-rate relief is not a vent. Kill dot-plot sleeve rotates.
nodes.watch_if: FOMC changes DFF or the statement changes QT language.

nodes.title: Fed balance sheet + RRP/TGA
facts: QT/QE/SRF plus RRP drain and TGA spend are the USD release family. Rate cuts without this may not vent funding stress.
nodes.interpretation: Do not split TGA vs SOMA on a 12-node board. Do not treat a TGA draw as an easing cycle. Loose/open ≠ residual deploy while FCC red.
nodes.watch_if: SRF take-up, QT taper, RRP collapse with TGA refill, or WALCL turns up.

source.name: NY Fed SOMA / FRED RRPONTSYD + WTREGEN

nodes.title: USDC peg + reserves
facts: USDC is working capital and Morpho principal denomination (MO §1). Peg break is a book event.
nodes.interpretation: open = par / mint working. shut = depeg. Social rumors off. Escalate CEX print <0.995 or attestation miss.
nodes.watch_if: USDC-USD <0.995 on a major CEX or Circle attestation miss.

nodes.title: On-chain USD float
facts: USDC+USDT supply is the crypto-dollar mint/burn valve. Distinct from peg integrity.
nodes.interpretation: Ignore day-to-day. Not a BTC timer. Re-read on ±5% 30d change.
